leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the list-style shorthand to configure bullet appearance, position, and image for unordered lists.
Implement custom counter-reset and counter-increment properties to create sequential numbering for ordered lists.
Construct a multi-level nested list with distinct list-style types at each level.
Manipulate counter values to display custom formats using the content property with counters.
Integrate list-style-image to replace default bullets with custom graphics.
Control the visual spacing and alignment of list items using list-style-position.
Initialize and render a custom counter that resets at specific container elements.
